entries.title: Job 30:1
segments: ¶"But now they mock at me, [men] younger than I, Whose fathers I disdained to put with the dogs of my flock.

entries.title: Job 30:2
segments: Indeed, what [profit] is the strength of their hands to me? Their vigor has perished.

entries.title: Job 30:3
segments: [They are] gaunt from want and famine, Fleeing late to the wilderness, desolate and waste,

entries.title: Job 30:4
segments: Who pluck mallow by the bushes, And broom tree roots [for] their food.

entries.title: Job 30:5
segments: They were driven out from among [men], They shouted at them as [at] a thief.

entries.title: Job 30:6
segments: [They had] to live in the clefts of the valleys, [In] caves of the earth and the rocks.

entries.title: Job 30:7
segments: Among the bushes they brayed, Under the nettles they nestled.

entries.title: Job 30:8
segments: [They were] sons of fools, Yes, sons of vile men; They were scourged from the land.

entries.title: Job 30:9
segments: "And now I am their taunting song; Yes, I am their byword.

entries.title: Job 30:10
segments: They abhor me, they keep far from me; They do not hesitate to spit in my face.

entries.title: Job 30:11
segments: Because He has loosed my bowstring and afflicted me, They have cast off restraint before me.

entries.title: Job 30:12
segments: At [my] right [hand] the rabble arises; They push away my feet, And they raise against me their ways of destruction.

entries.title: Job 30:13
segments: They break up my path, They promote my calamity; They have no helper.

entries.title: Job 30:14
segments: They come as broad breakers; Under the ruinous storm they roll along.

entries.title: Job 30:15
segments: ¶Terrors are turned upon me; They pursue my honor as the wind, And my prosperity has passed like a cloud.

entries.title: Job 30:16
segments: "And now my soul is poured out because of my [plight]; The days of affliction take hold of me.

entries.title: Job 30:17
segments: My bones are pierced in me at night, And my gnawing pains take no rest.

entries.title: Job 30:18
segments: By great force my garment is disfigured; It binds me about as the collar of my coat.

entries.title: Job 30:19
segments: He has cast me into the mire, And I have become like dust and ashes.

entries.title: Job 30:20
segments: "I cry out to You, but You do not answer me; I stand up, and You regard me.

entries.title: Job 30:21
segments: [But] You have become cruel to me; With the strength of Your hand You oppose me.

entries.title: Job 30:22
segments: You lift me up to the wind and cause me to ride [on it]; You spoil my success.

entries.title: Job 30:23
segments: For I know [that] You will bring me [to] death, And [to] the house appointed for all living.

entries.title: Job 30:24
segments: "Surely He would not stretch out [His] hand against a heap of ruins, If they cry out when He destroys [it].

entries.title: Job 30:25
segments: Have I not wept for him who was in trouble? Has [not] my soul grieved for the poor?

entries.title: Job 30:26
segments: But when I looked for good, evil came [to me]; And when I waited for light, then came darkness.

entries.title: Job 30:27
segments: My heart is in turmoil and cannot rest; Days of affliction confront me.

entries.title: Job 30:28
segments: I go about mourning, but not in the sun; I stand up in the assembly [and] cry out for help.

entries.title: Job 30:29
segments: I am a brother of jackals, And a companion of ostriches.

entries.title: Job 30:30
segments: My skin grows black and falls from me; My bones burn with fever.

entries.title: Job 30:31
segments: My harp is [turned] to mourning, And my flute to the voice of those who weep.
